rationale: User authorized maximum LLM spend of $150 total. The mb-cost report shows $63.62 cumulative across 1027 calls, but actual billed spend is now ~$86.50 — $22.88 of under-counting. The actual_offset is added to every recorded total before checking against the cap. Bumped by $2.50 on 2026-06-02 for 4 unrecorded Bedrock attempts that failed verify, then by another $3.00 same day for ~8 more attempts (the LLM_PROVIDER=bedrock BACKEND=llm path via examples/<model>/run.sh constructs BedrockClient via make_llm_client() with NO log_path arg, and the script doesn't export BEDROCK_CALLS_LOG, so those calls bypass benchmarks/results/*/llm_calls.jsonl entirely and mb-cost can't see them). FIX: examples/_run_lib.sh should export BEDROCK_CALLS_LOG=$EXAMPLE_DIR/$QUANT/bedrock_calls.jsonl before invoking BACKEND=llm path; alternatively bedrock_client.BedrockClient.__init__ default for log_path could fall back to ~/.modelblaster/llm_calls.jsonl.
